plan.reason: The forecast predicts a cold day with temperatures dropping below -15°C by mid-afternoon. Given that the warmest zone is already at 21.0°C and there are no zones currently asking for cooling, it's important to set the ceiling high enough to avoid overcooling and potential chilling of air in the perimeter zones. Setting the supply air temperature ceiling at 16.8°C ensures that even on the coldest forecasted days, the system will not be overly cold, thus avoiding unnecessary reheat loads and overheating of core areas.
